dct_description_sm:
The Downtown District or "DD" is an area zoned as a Comprehensive Development District. Within this overall district are smaller areas with specific regulations relating to land use and density which are displayed on this layer.

Data currency

This data in City systems is updated in the normal course of business, however priorities and resources determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database. The extract on this web site is updated weekly.

Data accuracy

Areas are generally based on street or alleyway centrelines and boundary locations are therefore approximate.
